name: Atlas Air Worldwide
reason: Atlas Air announced on Oct 19, 2023 that its new corporate headquarters would be in White Plains, New York, with a move expected in January 2024, and that it would retain 400 full-time permanent jobs in New York. The same press release describes Atlas as a leading global provider of outsourced aircraft and aviation operating services, and says it also employs 265 people based at JFK.
